description: Transcribe (or translate) audio or video speech to text. Default provider: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (NEW Nov 2026) — 0.3 credits per MINUTE of audio, up to 60 min / 200 MB, MP3/WAV/M4A/FLAC/OGG/WEBM/MP4/MOV, spoken language auto-detected, 32 languages. timestamps=true adds word timings + speaker labels (saved as a JSON file); target_language translates (to/from English). provider="elevenlabs" uses ElevenLabs Scribe (paused while it fails upstream).

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio (or a video with sound). Upload local files with upload_file first.

diarize.description: ElevenLabs only: identify speakers (Nemotron does this with timestamps=true)

download_dir.description: Absolute directory for the timestamps JSON (defaults to kie/assets/raw/)

estimate_only.description: Return the estimated credit cost WITHOUT submitting anything. Use before expensive runs (video, 4K, 1080p upgrades, layer splits).

language_code.description: ElevenLabs only: language code (auto-detected if omitted)

max_credits.description: Refuse to submit if the estimated cost exceeds this many credits (overrides KIE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL). Estimates come from published rates; kie bills the actual amount.

tag_audio_events.description: ElevenLabs only: tag laughter, music, etc.

target_language.description: Nemotron: translate instead of transcribe. Non-English speech → "en", or English speech → another language

timestamps.description: Nemotron: word-level timings + speaker labels (diarization). Cannot be combined with target_language

name: speech_to_text
